reuse.why: Linking goes through the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked/linkBankSyncAccount/findOrCreateBank helpers and the akahu balance branch is extended rather than copied, but the download function re-creates the per-provider post/error/shape logic since no shared downloader exists.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a near-verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions (and Pluggy's), adding another copy of the same request/error/response mapping block instead of factoring a shared single-account downloader.

placement.why: Link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts and type in types/models, exactly where the tree puts each provider's pieces.

scope.why: Only server-side Fintegra plumbing plus a release note; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: Follows the established provider pattern cleanly and reuses the link helper; the extra copied download function is the only maintenance cost.

bypasses_abstraction.where: linkFintegraAccount uses linkBankSyncAccount; no existing download abstraction is bypassed.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions in sync.ts is an open, renamed-only copy of downloadAkahuTransactions, not disguised.
